panel.title: Inspect Recent Runs (last 10)
panel.description: SELECTED RUN · Browse mode: latest ten pipeline-run reports found on disk for the selected pipeline. The dashboard time picker does not filter this table. Started is identity.started_at. Workflow is identity.workflow_id from that pipeline report (not the workflow-run catalog and not $workflow). Workflow run is identity.workflow_run_id (parent occurrence). $pipeline is a pipeline name (chembl_assay, chembl_target, chembl_publication), not a workflow (chembl_baseline). Workflow artifacts live under reports/run-reports/workflow/<name>/ and GET /ops/observability/workflow-run-reports. Click a Run cell to set var-run_id, var-pipeline, and var-run_type from that row, stay on this dashboard, and expand Selected Run Details below (row under this table; also a panel link). The matching row is marked when $run_id is set. Pipeline and run_type are already selectors, so they are hidden here to keep the UUID readable. Older runs: pick Run ID from the control-plane catalog (newest first); first screen is last 10 by design (limit=10). An empty table is valid when no matching reports exist for this pipeline (index_state=valid_empty). A TREE_MISSING / LAYOUT_UNHEALTHY / IDENTITY_UNHEALTHY row is bind or origin failure, not a selector problem — run python scripts/ops/runtime/docker/verify_report_bind.py from the checkout you are viewing. If reports are expected and the table is empty without that row, treat backend unavailable as a distinct failure and verify BioETL Ops HTTP at /health/live. SELECT RUN / VALID EMPTY is not OK.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — no pipeline-run-report artifacts for the selected pipeline under reports/run-reports/pipeline/<name>/ (first screen is last 10).
